title: Sequence-to-Sequence
motto: Two RNNs pretending to be a translator. The bottleneck they hit is the reason attention exists.

steps.title: Core idea
steps.body: Two RNNs pretending to be a translator. The bottleneck they hit is the reason attention exists.

steps.title: Why this matters
cards: Classification maps a variable-length sequence to a single label. Translation maps a variable-length sequence to another variable-length sequence. The input and output live in different vocabularies, possibly different languages, with no guarantee of length parity.

The seq2seq architecture (Sutskever, Vinyals, Le, 2014) cracked this with a deliberately simple recipe. Two RNNs. One reads the source sentence and produces a fixed-size context vector. The other reads that vector and generates the target sentence token by token. Same code you wrote for lesson 08, glued together differently.

steps.title: The concept
steps.body: Encoder compresses input; decoder generates output token by token. Foundation of translation.
